posts.zh:
dsh-rule-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a78a9f0c2f593d912f2.html
posts.en:
dsh-rule-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a78a9f0c2f593d912f2.html
